acceptanceCriteria: Preserve every WI-1111 archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, Events, report, manifest, verification, and recovery receipt byte unchanged.

Keep the fixed-history clone helper on the local Git filesystem path, preserving --shared --no-checkout isolation, and make the regression tests pass with paths containing spaces on supported platforms.

With core.autocrlf=true, preserve exact .ai artifact bytes for current and historical fixture checkouts; keep strict digest and byte-equality assertions, and prove a one-byte tamper is still rejected.
Do not change CI workflows or global Git configuration, and do not weaken, skip, or normalize the existing byte-integrity assertions.
Run the full declared local workspace verification and zero-warning Clippy; do not claim Windows-hosted CI success until a later authorized hosted run passes.

The active WI-1112 human handoff exposes a separately versioned, read-only delivery-continuity projection derived from a valid predecessor/successor lineage. It distinguishes the frozen local archive, outstanding external validation, active repair, and the Runtime-admitted next action. Missing, stale, contradictory, or invalid evidence never appears delivered or complete. The predecessor archive Contract, Summary, Outcome, Events, reports, and manifest remain byte-identical. OutcomeDelivery.deliveryState remains a handoff transport state.

The read-only material plan may show predecessor-review context only after validating the repository-bound recovery lineage and exact material identities. It highlights unchanged predecessor-reviewed Unknowns without discharging them or satisfying the current WI request. A fresh receipt remains bound to WI-1112 and its current request. Any changed or new path, blob, hunk, cause, Contract, scope, scanner, policy, or profile invalidates the comparison; new Findings or Unknowns remain unresolved.
previousContract.goal: Make local Git fixture cloning platform-safe and preserve exact .ai historical artifact bytes in Windows checkouts without weakening archive integrity.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Archive remains frozen; overall delivery stays pending and no close/completion is projected.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: The current request contains the same three predecessor-reviewed Unknown path/blob/hunk identities.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Plan displays the exact unchanged context, preserves raw Unknowns, and requires a fresh WI-1112-bound receipt.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: A source blob/hunk, scope, Contract, profile, policy, scanner identity, or cause changes, or a new Finding/Unknown appears.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: No old context is treated as covering the changed request; the new material remains unresolved.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: CLI and MCP render the same current continuity projection while reading an unchanged legacy archive.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Archived wire bytes stay unchanged; the new projection is separately versioned and is not inserted into legacy events or reports.
